title: Sentinel-2 Quarterly Cloudless Mosaics
description: A full mirror of the [Copernicus Sentinel-2 Global Mosaics](https://documentation.dataspace.copernicus.eu/Data/Others/Sentinel2_Mosaic_Algorithm.html) (product `S2MSI_L3__MCQ`): quarterly cloud-free composites of the Sentinel-2 archive at 10 m, 36 quarters from 2017 Q1 through 2025 Q4. Every mosaic pixel is the 25th percentile of that quarter's cloud-masked Level-2A surface reflectance observations for that pixel, which suppresses residual haze and misclassified bright cloud instead of averaging it in. Four bands publish: blue (B02), green (B03), red (B04) and wide near-infrared (B08), each a single-band Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF that an HTTP client can read a window out of without a key or an account. Upstream the same product sits behind the [Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem](https://dataspace.copernicus.eu) sign-in; this copy is anonymous and open. The `mosaics` collection holds the imagery and its item index. The `coverage` collection holds per-tile, per-quarter statistics and tile footprints, so a client can plan a query before running it. The European Space Agency produces the mosaics; [Taylor Geospatial Engine](https://tgengine.org) hosts this mirror. Read the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) before you query it.
